svg.text: Top-level Dioxus component that owns the UI shell layout and routes focus/select
UI framework interface used to declare layouts, render widgets, and process user
Left navigation pane that presents a tree view derived from shortest paths from
the mission root, enabling fast card discovery and focus changes.
Contract for reading and writing Aurora model files on the local filesystem (ope
n, read, write, atomic replace, and directory enumeration).
Standalone desktop application (built with Dioxus) for browsing and editing Auro
ra models, including live validation and Markdown-style previews.
Central pane that renders a mind-map / TheBrain-style context graph with the foc
used card centered and related cards positioned by relationship role.
Public domain interface (Rust API) for discovering model homes, loading cards, v
alidating invariants, and rendering Markdown-style representations.
Right pane that splits vertically: top half edits the focused card; bottom half
shows a rendered Markdown-style preview (and links) with a tab to reveal audit d
In-memory model session that loads a workspace model home, computes shortest pat
hs, validates changes, and persists updated card files using aurora_shared seman
